reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis that Co removal increases SFE is physically backwards; Co is known to increase SFE in this system, so its removal should decrease SFE, undermining the proposed slip-to-twinning shift.
reasons.testability: The proposed test with paired in situ EBSD/TEM and quantitative twin density measurements is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if no difference is found.
reasons.usefulness: Despite being physically incorrect, the hypothesis addresses a relevant comparison and would stimulate necessary clarification of SFE trends, but its wrong direction makes it misleading rather than useful.
